select SEC_ACCT_ID code, SEC_ACCT_ID name, SEC_ACCT_NAME shortName, SEC_ACCT_ID hidCode FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO
SEC_ACCT_ID like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId},'%')) or SEC_ACCT_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId},'%'))
AND STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.sec_acct_type = 'FUND'/*只查询基金账户*/

select CUSTOMER_ID code, CUSTOMER_ID name, NVL(CUSTOMER_ABBR,CUSTOMER_NAME) shortName, CUSTOMER_ID hidCode FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE 1=1 AND is_asste_manager = 'Y' /*客户性质配置为管理人的机构*/
AND ( CUSTOMER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{manager},'%')) or NVL(CUSTOMER_ABBR,CUSTOMER_NAME) like concat('%',concat(#{manager},'%')) )

select CUSTOMER_ID id, NVL(CUSTOMER_ABBR,CUSTOMER_NAME) text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where 1=1 AND is_asste_manager = 'Y' /*客户性质配置为管理人的机构*/
and ( CUSTOMER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{manager},'%')) or NVL(CUSTOMER_ABBR,CUSTOMER_NAME) like concat('%',concat(#{manager},'%')) )

select SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, SEC_ACCT_SOURCE secAcctSource, REGIST_ORG registOrg, TRD_ACCT_ID trdAcctId, REC_ACCT_ID recAcctId, REMARK remark, CREATE_USER createUser, CREATE_DEPT createDept, CREATE_TIME createTime, UPDATE_USER updateUser, UPDATE_TIME updateTime, TRADE_PLACE tradePlace, SEC_ACCT_SOURCE secAcctSource, MANAGER manager from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO WHERE SEC_ACCT_ID=#{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.sec_acct_type = 'FUND'/*只查询基金账户*/
select count(*) from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO WHERE SEC_ACCT_Name=#{secAcctName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.sec_acct_type = 'FUND'/*只查询基金账户*/
select count(*) count from PTL_SEC_ACCT T1 ,STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO T2 where T1.ACCT_NO=T2.SEC_ACCT_ID and T2.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T2.sec_acct_type = 'FUND'/*只查询基金账户*/
